source_text: Of all 100 samples, 99% had the kdr east (Vgsc_1014S) mutation and the remaining one had the kdr west (Vgsc_1014F) gene mutation. This high frequency of kdr east mutation indicated fixation in the mosquito population and thus precluded further correlation analysis between microbial composition and kdr allele frequencies.
